name: a sky with a shape to it
did: An environment probe at HIGH and ULTRA: the sky is baked into a cubemap and prefiltered by roughness, so a mid-rough metal now blurs its reflection properly instead of fading to a flat grey. Diffuse ambient comes from a nine-term spherical-harmonic fit of the same sky.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
